_evidence: MEASURED (config.json's own richly-structured sub-configs + one safetensors header, every tensor bucketed by top-level component with an explicit zero-unaccounted-bytes assertion). Zero mlx/torch load, zero HCLI resident contention.
_label: Odyssey I DISCOVERY. Pure vision/video specimen -- zero tokenizer, zero text modality at all, the second specimen this session (after pi0_base) with no language component whatsoever.

domain.modality: promptable image AND video segmentation -- point/box/mask prompts in, per-object segmentation masks out, with a MEMORY mechanism for tracking objects across video frames. No text/language input or output anywhere in this checkpoint.

architecture_CONFIRMED_FROM_TENSORS.finding: vision_encoder (the Hiera hierarchical vision transformer backbone) is 94.77% of total params -- a BACKBONE-DOMINATED distribution, structurally the inverse of every language specimen surveyed this session (there, embedding tables or MoE experts compete with or exceed the core transformer stack; here the mask_decoder, prompt_encoder, and full video-memory mechanism TOGETHER are only 5.23% of the model).

memory_mechanism.components: memory_attention + memory_encoder (which itself contains a memory_fuser sub-module) + no_memory_embedding/no_memory_positional_encoding (learned fallbacks for the first frame, which has no prior memory yet) -- together 7.31M params (3.26% of total).
memory_mechanism.structural_comparison_question_NOT_A_CLA: num_maskmem bounds how many past-frame memory features SAM2 retains for video tracking -- superficially similar in SPIRIT to a bounded/evicted KV-cache or a fixed-size SSM recurrent state (both examined for A5/O001 earlier in this campaign), but the MECHANISM is different (cross-attention over a small stored feature bank, not a recurrent state update or a growing-then-evicted KV). Recorded as a genuine open comparison question this session's A5 work raises, not asserted as a transfer rule from a single loose analogy.

byte_accounting_EXACT.dtype: F32 throughout (same as pi0_base -- second non-language specimen this session shipping without a bf16 cast, tentative pattern worth watching, not yet a rule).

obvious_representation_opportunities: All-F32 storage on a 224M-param model is the obvious first lever, untested this pass: a bf16 cast alone would roughly halve the 856 MiB footprint. Given the vision_encoder's dominance (94.7%), that one component is where nearly all of the saving would come from.

The task-specific heads (mask_decoder 4.22M, prompt_encoder 0.01M) are already so small relative to the backbone that they are poor Gravity targets -- unlike every MoE specimen this session, where the expert organ was the obvious dominant-organ attack surface, here the vision_encoder itself (a dense ViT-style hierarchical backbone, no MoE/sparsity structure at all) is the only organ worth attacking.
failure_modes_not_yet_tested: No capability battery (would need an actual segmentation benchmark -- e.g. COCO/SA-V -- entirely outside Hawking's existing text-oriented Doctor batteries).

The memory-mechanism structural comparison to SSM/KV-cache above is explicitly a QUESTION, not verified -- no measurement was made of whether Odyssey's SSM-organ Gravity priors have ANY bearing on this specimen's memory_attention/memory_encoder organs.
preliminary_disposition: RESEARCH SPECIMEN, OUT-OF-DOMAIN FOR HCLI. Genuinely useful as a THIRD non-language data point this session (after evo2 and pi0_base) and the first with a backbone-dominated rather than embedding/expert-dominated byte budget -- valuable for architecture-diversity completeness, no bearing on HCLI's own text/code domain.

preliminary_star_resident_evaluation.resident_candidate: NOT APPLICABLE -- a vision/video segmentation model has no HCLI relevance (same reasoning as evo2 and pi0_base).
preliminary_star_resident_evaluation.verdict: OUT OF SCOPE for the Resident/Pulsar/Magnetar/Cepheid framework, recorded for architecture-diversity completeness per the creed -- the THIRD specimen this session in this category (evo2, pi0_base, now this one), all genuinely out-of-domain but genuinely diversity-valuable.
